rationale: Plan implements denial code analysis across all claims and denial rates across five requested dimensions (claim type, provider specialty, network status, place of service, authorization requirement). Following the evolved skill on denominator selection, denial rates use adjudicated_claims denominator to exclude Pended claims and accurately reflect denial performance. Missing codes are quantified overall relative to all claims. Report includes appropriate caveats for descriptive analysis with small-group flagging at 30-claim threshold.
